title: Mayor Mamdani on crutches after tearing his Achilles in soccer game

 Mayor Mamdani on crutches after tearing his Achilles in soccer game 
 The mayor just recently turned 35 years old. 
 Mayor Mamdani revealed he was playing soccer against media members when he was injured. Aaron Katersky Friday, November 20, 2026 3:25PM Share NEW YORK (WABC) -- Mayor Zohran Mamdani hobbled into a news conference on Friday morning in a boot and crutches after tearing his Achilles in a friendly game of soccer with the press corps.
 Mamdani, who just recently turned 35, suffered a non-contact injury while running for a ball on the indoor turf in the second half
 "I tore my Achilles," the mayor said at an unrelated press conference.
 "I did not stretch," before playing, he admitted
 Aaron Katersky "For those who don't know, we played a friendly game against the press corps last night, soccer, which we won 10-5," Mamdani said. "I scored a goal soon after getting on the pitch and I forgot that I was 35. Soon after, I tore my Achilles and I will be in a boot for six to eight weeks and I will play soccer in about nine months."
